title: Am I the only one who doesn’t feel trapped in Mall World?
content: Hell, I’m trying to get back there! My best writing ideas come after a good ramble through the Hidden City and the Mall, and its surrounding structures. I’m reading a lot of posts and comments about a common theme of being trapped or pursued. I haven’t had that sense in a dream since my father passed (a recurrent theme was going back to his house to retrieve clothes and makeup; those dreams abruptly stopped.) Instead now it seems I’m doing the pursuing, always looking for something specific. The only thing that irritates me sometimes is when I get distracted looking for a dress in my size, or getting stuck in that nasty bathroom. Except that bathroom is plastered with graffiti which, if I am patient, will reveal profound knowledge.
